decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - That details of  storage of refuse and waste,  pursuant to Condition 6 of approval ref. 00423/56/P4,  for the  erection of a four storey side extension and conversion of existing dwelling house to 4 x 1 bedroom flats and 4 x 2 bedroom flats incorporating replacement windows, vehicular/ pedestrian access  and 8 parking spaces, 3 of which are covered, covered cycle stand, refuse storage area and landscaping  dated 25/7/2002 received 5/8/2003,  be approved
	
Informative
It should be noted that The Council no longer empty from Paladin Bins and now only use 1100 Euro Bins.
description: Following approval for erection of a four storey side extension and conversion of existing dwellinghouse to 3 one bedroom flats and 5 two bedroom flats incorporating replacement windows vehicular/pedestrian access, 8 parking spaces (3 of which are covered) covered cycle stand, refuse storage area, and landscaping - details submitted pursuant to condition 6 (storage of refuse and waste) of permission dated 25/07/2002
